rationale: Positions the product as an autonomous experience optimization solution. The autonomy mechanism is not described, so the binary is weak and forced rather than supported non-AI, even though the described testing service is conventional.
ai_type_rationale: The described core is a multivariate testing and optimization service that can run without the autonomy claim. Whether autonomous optimization is core or an enhancement is unresolved, so enabled is a weak forced subtype.
evidence_spans: Ascend is the autonomous experience optimization solution for websites and mobile applications.
ai_type_evidence_spans: massively multivariate testing and optimization service that allows subscribers to test multiple improvements
